title: Check address forms and socket destination consistency

context.hint: Validate resolved image destinations and connect using the validated address.
context.surface: An HTML extraction CLI fetches supplied image URLs under a public-destination-only policy.
assumptions: Use controlled resolution and disposable network fixtures.

review.invariant: Address classification handles mapped forms and the socket uses a validated address.
review.verification: Check equivalent address forms and instrument connection lookup so a second resolution cannot substitute a denied destination. Inspect the returned fallback and retain an allowed-image control.

source_observation.summary: The baseline accepted a mapped address leading to the local fixture. The repaired CLI blocked it and used a pinned lookup in its regression matrix. Redirect revalidation was source-reviewed; the end-to-end redirect check remained inconclusive because the external control denied that redirect.
